entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'representative' to speak with an agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return an item. Order number is VF-8820-C9.

Okay, I can help with that. Let me just pull up that order... VF-8820-C9. Yes, I see it. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It looks like that was delivered 36 days ago. To get started, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band?
The issue is I tried to return it weeks ago and your website was broken. I don't need it. I want a refund.
I understand. I just need to clarify for my records, is it a technical fault with the device itself or more of a preference issue?
It's an issue with your company. I tried to do the return on day 9. I went online, but there was a huge **website error**. The whole return **system** was **down** and I **couldn't print** the label.
I see, so you were prevented from making the return due to a technical problem on our end. I do apologize for that. Do you remember the approximate date you tried?
Not the exact date. It was a weekend. I was so annoyed I even took a **screenshot** of the error page. I just want this processed.

That won't be necessary, I believe you. I can see a note in our system about a service outage around that time. I'm sorry you were impacted by that. Let me just check the return eligibility for you... one moment.
Okay, thanks for your patience. I've checked the policy, and it looks like items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.
Yes. Since you're at 36 days, you're well within that 90-day window. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm sending the pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file right now.
Okay. Good. That's all I needed.
Perfect. Just attach that label to the box and drop it off with the carrier. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued in 3-5 business days. Was there anything else for you today?
